comment: A curated mutant set: one entry per oracle rule that some vector or
self-test constrains. The harness in scripts/check-oracle-mutants.mjs
applies each mutant, runs the oracle suite, and requires the suite to
FAIL; a survivor means the rule it disables is constrained by nothing.
One rule is excluded on purpose: the all-zero shared-secret refusal in
seal.mjs. OpenSSL refuses the small-order computation natively, so no
vector can isolate the explicit check on this runtime; it stays in the
module as portability armor and is documented there.
A find string that no longer matches is an error, not a skip: it means
the module changed and this registry rotted. Update the entry with the
rule it pins, or delete it with the rule it pinned.

mutants.rule: RFC 8785: object members sort by UTF-16 code unit
§3.2: a signed-body number must be a safe integer
§3.2: negative zero is refused
mutants.find: if (Object.is(value, -0)) throw new Error("§3.2: negative zero");

mutants.rule: §3.2: a lone surrogate in a MEMBER NAME is refused, not only in a value
§3.2: the canonicalization walk is depth-bounded
§3.2: the walk is node-bounded
§3.2: canonical output is capped in UTF-16 code units
§3.2: canonical output is capped in UTF-8 bytes as well
§3.6: the signature member is removed before canonicalizing
§3.3: a scalar carrying CR or LF refuses at base construction
mutants.find:
if (/[\r\n]/.test(value))
      throw new Error(`§3.3: ${name} contains CR or LF`);
mutants.replace:
if (false)
      throw new Error(`§3.3: ${name} contains CR or LF`);

mutants.rule: §7: only the Ed25519 multicodec forms a key-derived principal
RFC 6962: the leaf hash is domain-separated with 0x00
RFC 6962: the interior node hash is domain-separated with 0x01
ink-merkle-inclusion.md: proof elements are ordered top-down
ink-merkle-inclusion.md: a padded or short proof is rejected
ink-inclusion-receipt.md: the witness signs the five committed members only
mutants.find: jcs({ eventId, leafIndex, rootHash, timestamp, treeSize })

mutants.rule: §3.6: the audit query response preimage excludes serviceSignature
ink-authorization-chain.md: a link resolves against ITS OWN issuer key
mutants.replace: const key = issuerKeys.find((k: any) => k?.status === "active") ?? issuerKeys[i];

mutants.rule: accepted chainRaw vectors are parsed, not silently skipped
§3.4: the AAD starts with the ink/0.1:envelope domain line
§3.4: the AES key derives with info ink/0.1/encrypt
§3.4 step 10: the inner to must equal the mandatory recipient DID
mutants.find:
if (typeof recipientDid !== "string" || recipientDid.length === 0) return null;
    if (inner.to !== recipientDid) return null;

mutants.rule: §3.4 step 10: the inner from must equal the outer from (isolated by the fixed inner-from-mismatch vector)
agent-authorization: only an ACTIVE relying-party key is a signer candidate
mutants.find: const candidates = keys.filter((k: any) => k?.status === "active" && typeof k.publicKeyHex === "string");
mutants.replace: const candidates = keys.filter((k: any) => typeof k.publicKeyHex === "string");

mutants.rule: the rejected-chain check verifies link 1 against the identity root, not the card field
mutants.find: const underId = await verify(link.signature, base, decodePublicKeyMultibase(idRoot));
mutants.replace: const underId = await verify(link.signature, base, decodePublicKeyMultibase(fieldRoot));
